html.body: Date: 2025-03-05 REMARKSStatus of the Application Claims 1-20 are pending in the application.Claim 10 is indicated as containing allowable subject matter.The Amendment is made without prejudice or disclaimer. No new matter is added.Preliminary Matters Applicant thanks the Examiner for returning the PTO/SB/08 form submitted with the Information Disclosure Statement on October 28, 2022, indicating consideration of the reference listed therein.Applicant kindly requests the Examiner acknowledge the drawings filed on October 28, 2022.Statement of Substance of Interview Applicant thanks the Examiner for the courtesies extended during the interview of January 8, 2025.During the interview, the Examiner and the undersigned discussed potential amendments to claim 1 as set forth herein. The Examiner indicated that the potential amendments to claim 1 would overcome the cited art of record and further search would be needed.It is respectfully submitted that the instant STATEMENT OF SUBSTANCE OF INTERVIEW complies with the requirements of 37 C.F.R. 1.2 and 1.133 and MPEP § 713.04.Claim Objections Claims 2-14 and 16-19 are objected to because of the alleged informalities. Without any admissions, in view of the present amendments to the claims, withdrawal of these objections is respectfully requested.Claim Rejections - 35 U.S.C. §103 Claims 1, 3-4, 9, 15, 20 are rejected under 35 U.S.C. 103 as being unpatentable over Zmijewski et al. (2020/0143197, hereinafter "Zmijewski") in view of Neustaedter et al.(2010/0050088, hereinafter "Neustaedter").Claims 2 and 16 are rejected under 35 U.S.C. 102(a)(1) as being anticipated by Zmijewski in view of Neustaedter, further in view of France (2020/0279458).Claim 5 is rejected under 35 U.S.C. 102(a)(1) as being anticipated by Zmijewski in view of Neustaedter, further in view of Kelly et al. (2009/0118006, hereinafter "Kelly").Claims 6-8, 19 are rejected under 35 U.S.C. 102(a)(1) as being anticipated by Zmijewski in view of Neustaedter, Kelly, further in view of Chung et al. (2008/0126939, hereinafter "Chung").Claim 11 is rejected under 35 U.S.C. 103 as being unpatentable over Zmijewski in view of Neustaedter, further in view of Honda et al. (2016/0199739).Claim 12 is rejected under 35 U.S.C. 103 as being unpatentable over Zmijewski in view of Neustaedter, further in view of Kunieda et al. (2017/0065885).Claim 13 is rejected under 35 U.S.C. 103 as being unpatentable over Zmijewski in view of Neustaedter, further in view of Prasad et al. (2021/0209559).Claim 14 is rejected under 35 U.S.C. 102(a)(1) as being anticipated by Zmijewski in view of Neustaedter, Kelly, Chung, further in view of Schanel et al. (6304272).Claim 17 is rejected under 35 U.S.C. 103 as being unpatentable over Zmijewski in view of Neustaedter, further in view of Hayashida et al. (2015/0224409).Without any admissions, independent claims 1, 15, and 20 are amended to reflect the subject matter of allowable claim 10. Applicant respectfully submits that allowance of independent claims 1, 15, and 20 and all claims dependent therefrom is warranted.Conclusion In view of the above, reconsideration and allowance of this application are now believed to be in order, and such actions are hereby solicited. If any points remain in issue which the Examiner feels may be best resolved through a personal or telephone interview, the Examiner is kindly requested to contact the undersigned at the telephone number listed below.The USPTO is directed and authorized to charge all required fees, except for the Issue Fee and the Publication Fee, to Deposit Account No. 19-4880. Please also credit any overpayments to said Deposit Account.Respectfully submitted, / Sujin Park / SUGHRUE MION, PLLC Sujin Park Telephone: 202.293.7060 Registration No. 74,061 Facsimile: 202.293.7860 WASHINGTON OFFICE23373 CUSTOMER NUMBERDate: March 5, 2025
